name: Jeune Styliste 3: Star
summary: Young Stylist 3 Star on PC lets you create the look of the stars. Imagine their outfits for a concert, a fashion show, or an interview on the Croisette... Rediscover the world of the Young Stylist collection with Anna, the faithful assistant. Apply makeup with professional precision: blush, eyeliner, lipstick... Cast your cast and stage your fashion show. Choose the decor, music, and order of appearances to bask in the glory.
